Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26692` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26692 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6444153925, verbatim: "The test awaits the catalogue (`findBy` / a loaded signal). ⛔ No sleep, no retry wrapper, no quarantine." The maintainer's word it cites: 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」.

### Scope

File surface: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx` only (test-only fix; no source change). Then sweep: list every other test under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` that asserts a zh string from the `studio` namespace synchronously after an await that does not wait on the catalogue; fix the same way in the same PR if ≤5 files, else report them as one finding.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure)

- On `origin/main` `d31329f1`, the test awaits only `findByTestId('auto-canvas-caption')` (L134) and asserts `title="API 名称: …"` synchronously (L148). The established fix in this repo is a top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')` (used by #26593 and #26780); a `findBy`/`waitFor` on the title is the triage's other spelling. Pick one, say which.
- Prove determinism: the card's red is intermittent, so show the test red when the zh chunk is withheld (ablation) and green with the fix.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S, test-only). No changeset (test-only).
